why_it_matters: THE SHAPE THAT BREAKS THE PROPOSED RULE. The vendor notes conclude 'an error is a body carrying errorMessage, or status:"ERROR"'. This body carries NEITHER: it is `status: "failed"` with the message hidden under `data` as a {code: message} map. That rule would read this as a success and hand the caller `{"813": "Invalid SecurityId"}` as data. Three different malformed requests -- unknown underlying, bad segment, and a missing required field -- all produced this identical body, so it does not say what was wrong either.
